I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/njs`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
A use-of-uninitialized/invalid-memory read in Array.prototype.join causes a crash: njs_array_prototype_join passes an invalid/uninitialized string value into the buffer append code, triggering a read from an invalid address inside njs_chb_append0 (njs_chb.c). This leads to a segmentation fault/undefined behavior when joining array elements and can be triggered by crafted inputs (resulting in crashes or potential memory corruption).
